messages.subject: WITHOUT PREJUDICE - Saxena and Halstead Aerospace
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Ms Marsh,

Please find attached a without-prejudice letter opening a protected conversation under s.111A ERA 1996 in relation to your client. Without admission of liability, our client proposes an agreed exit on the terms set out, including an ex gratia payment of £95,000 and a payment in lieu of notice. The offer is open until 5pm on 17 February. I look forward to your response.

James Osei
Senior Associate | Employment
Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ | +44 (0)20 7946 0211

messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Mr Osei,

Thank you. My client is willing to engage but the ex gratia figure is some way short of where this needs to be given the uncapped nature of the claim and her schedule of loss, which exceeds £300,000. Our counter is £160,000 ex gratia, a £1,500 legal fee contribution, outplacement, and an agreed reference. We can move quickly if the figure is right.

Olivia Marsh
Partner | Drummond Hale LLP
